title: A black hole eats a Sun every day

scenes.voiceover: Somewhere out there... a black hole is eating an entire Sun every single day. Not metaphorically. Literally. And it's not even the most disturbing thing I'm going to show you tonight.
scenes.mainText: A BLACK HOLE EATS A SUN A DAY

scenes.voiceover: Its name is J0529 dash 4351. Seventeen billion times the mass of our Sun... and its accretion disc alone is seven light-years wide. Fifteen thousand times the distance from our Sun to Neptune.

stat.label: SOLAR MASSES — THE BRIGHTEST OBJECT EVER FOUND

scenes.voiceover: Nobody knows how this ends yet. Not really. That's the part that should terrify and delight you in equal measure. Subscribe to mindwired... because I'm not done looking.

title: You'd never see them cross the event horizon

scenes.voiceover: Now here's the one that keeps me up at night. If you watched a friend fall into a black hole... you would never actually see them cross the edge.
scenes.mainText: YOU WOULD NEVER SEE THEM CROSS

scenes.voiceover: To you, watching from outside... they freeze. They dim. They fade to black, forever, never quite disappearing. But to them? They feel nothing. They cross instantly, and keep falling.
scenes.mainText: THEY FREEZE FOREVER. THEY FEEL NOTHING.
scenes.kicker: TWO PEOPLE, TWO REALITIES, BOTH TRUE

title: 94% of the universe is already gone

scenes.voiceover: And now, the one that actually changed how I see the night sky. Most of what you can see up there... you can never, ever visit.
scenes.mainText: YOU WILL NEVER REACH MOST OF THE SKY

scenes.voiceover: Ninety-four percent of the galaxies in our observable universe are already permanently unreachable. Space itself is expanding faster than light could ever cross it. Even if you left today, at light speed... you would never, ever arrive.
scenes.kicker: EVEN AT THE SPEED OF LIGHT

stat.label: OF THE UNIVERSE YOU CAN NEVER REACH

scenes.voiceover: And here's the strangest part. The thing pushing all of that away — dark energy — might be weakening. If it is... the universe stops expanding. And starts, instead, to fall back in on itself.
scenes.mainText: "IT MIGHT ALL FALL BACK IN ON ITSELF"
scenes.kicker: DESI 2025 — AN UNRESOLVED DEBATE, NOT A FACT
